display.purpose: Reserved editorial display for rare landing brand moments. Loaded but not currently applied; never in product UI.

heading.purpose: Page and section titles. Medium weight (500), tight tracking.

title.purpose: Card titles, screen titles, list headers.

label.purpose: Field labels and at most one section eyebrow. Uppercase, tracked. Used sparingly.

mono.purpose: Code blocks and technical values in the in-app tutorials.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: The default lift for floating chips, elevated cards, and dropdowns. The only shadow most surfaces ever use.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Sheets and larger overlays. Used rarely.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and reveals. Exponential ease-out, no bounce.

motion.name: reveal-fade-in
motion.purpose: Section reveal on the landing. Must have a still fallback under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: ambient-orbit
motion.purpose: The hero orbit rings only. Extremely slow, masked, grayscale. The single piece of ambient decoration.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action. Ink-filled full pill with an inverse label. Mobile is a generous 52px pill; web is more compact.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #0A0A0A; color: #FAFAFA; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1f1f1f; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,10,10,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Brand Button
components.description: The single highest-intent action (onboarding, paywall, get started). The one place the Spark yellow appears as a fill. At most one per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 16px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: #FFE040; color: #1A1A1A; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-brand:hover { background: #F2D32B; } .ds-btn-brand:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,224,64,0.45); } .ds-btn-brand:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. Surface-gray fill, ink label, modest 10px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #F5F5F5; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ECECEC; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,10,10,0.18); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet action on a paper surface. Hairline border, ink label, fills to surface gray on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 22px; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #F5F5F5; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,10,10,0.18); }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default container. Flat by default: a 1px hairline (expressed as a 10% ink ring), white paper, 16px radius, no drop shadow at rest. Never nested.
components.html:
Last sync
All 142 moments are up to date across your devices.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding: 16px 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(10,10,10,0.10); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 15px; color: #0A0A0A; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #737373; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line field. Hairline border, paper fill, 12px radius, 44px min height. Focus shifts the border to ink with a subtle ring; no heavy glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #737373; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0A0A0A; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,10,10,0.12); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status or metadata chip. Surface fill, ink text, full-pill. Status variants may use a faint semantic wash.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #F5F5F5; color: #0A0A0A; font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: The one uppercase tracked label style. For field labels and at most one section eyebrow. Never stacked above every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Geist Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #737373; }

narrative.overview: NowStack is rendered almost entirely in ink and paper - near-black type on white, with gray for everything secondary - and lit by exactly one chromatic color: a confident yellow (#FFE040). The discipline is the design. A buyer reads this interface the way they read clean code: nothing is decorative, every weight and border is load-bearing, and the one spot of color means 'this is the thing to press.' It should feel like the considered, production version of an app a senior engineer already shipped once - calm, exact, and quietly expensive. The system carries one identity across four surfaces (the Expo mobile app, the web landing, the signed-in /app, and the /admin dashboard). They differ in density, not in language: the same ink-pill primary button, the same hairline-bordered card, the same yellow spark.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome foundation (ink #0A0A0A, paper #FFFFFF, gray #737373) plus a single yellow spark.
Primary actions are an ink-filled full pill; the highest-intent moment can wear the yellow.
Flat by default - depth is a 1px hairline, not a drop shadow.
Clean medium-weight sans (Geist on web, DM Sans on mobile); Geist Mono for code.
Modest radii (8-16px) and generous touch targets (>=44px), never over-rounded.
First-class light and dark themes; the mono palette inverts cleanly.

rules.name: The Single Spark Rule
rules.body: The yellow #FFE040 appears on <=10% of any screen - ideally one element. Its rarity is the entire point; two yellows on a screen is a bug. If a screen needs a second emphasis, use ink weight, not a second color.

rules.name: The No-Indigo Rule
rules.body: The default shadcn --primary (oklch 0.488 0.243 264) is a vestigial create-app default, not the brand. Never use indigo, violet, sky, or blue as a UI accent. Re-point --primary to Ink so /app and /admin match the landing.

rules.name: The Medium-Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings sit at 500 (medium), not 700/800. A refined product whispers; size and -0.02em tracking carry the hierarchy. Black, heavy display weights read as a louder, cheaper product.

rules.name: The Sparing-Label Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked Label style is for field labels and at most one section eyebrow - never a kicker stacked above every section.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A resting card is a 1px line, not a shadow. If you reach for a drop shadow on a static surface, you've over-lifted it - use the hairline instead.

rules.name: The No-Ghost-Card Rule
rules.body: Never combine a 1px border with a soft wide drop shadow (blur >= 16px) on the same element. Pick one: a hairline OR a defined shadow-sm (blur <= 8px).

dos: Do keep the palette monochrome and ration the yellow: ink, paper, and gray carry the page; #FFE040 marks the one thing to press.
Do make the primary CTA an ink-filled full pill, and reserve the yellow pill for the single highest-intent action on a screen.
Do convey depth with a 1px hairline (ring-1 ring-foreground/10 / border-border); add shadow-sm only to lift floating or interactive elements.
Do set headings at medium weight (500) with tight tracking (-0.02em); let size, not heaviness, carry hierarchy.
Do keep one identity across mobile, landing, /app, and /admin - same buttons, cards, and spark everywhere.
Do use #1A1A1A (Spark-Ink) for text on the yellow - it reads at 12:1.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: every reveal and the hero orbit need a still fallback.
donts: Don't reintroduce the default shadcn indigo-violet accent, or any indigo / violet / sky / blue as a UI accent. Re-point --primary to Ink.
Don't use gradient orbs, blurred color blobs, or decorative glows as background filler.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default surface - translucency is allowed only for the occasional floating chip, never for primary panels.
Don't build the hero-metric template (giant number, tiny label, gradient accent, repeat).
Don't ship identical icon + heading + paragraph card grids repeated down a page.
Don't stack a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow over every section.
Don't put white text on the yellow (1.06:1, unreadable) - always Spark-Ink.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide soft shadow - the 'ghost card' is forbidden.
Don't over-round: cards top out at ~18px, non-pill buttons at 10px.
Don't use Muted-Ink (#737373) for primary body copy - it's the 4.5:1 floor; use Ink.
Don't let anything read as a free, auto-generated template. It's a $200 product; restraint is the proof.
